reason: Verification failed on critical domain requirements: schema mismatch, missing entities/interactions (households, locations, retailers, enforcement, misinformation), and absent required metrics. With three iterations remaining, a focused pass can implement a minimal viable domain model, schema adapter, event logs, and metrics, and fix calibrators to use the evaluator—likely enough to pass verification.

specific_areas: Add a schema adapter and update plan/parameter loaders to accept the task specification (dict-style parameters) alongside the internal schema.

Implement minimal domain entities and processes: Person (with attributes/inventory), Household (norm reinforcement, coordinated purchases), Location (attendance, enforcement, fines), Retailer (inventory, restock, price), MediaChannel (credibility, reach, misinformation_rate), PolicyMaker (mandate windows, enforcement levels).
Implement purchasing and supply constraints; track purchases and per-person inventory consumption.
Implement location attendance with admit/reject and fines; log enforcement actions.
Implement misinformation exposures via MediaChannel sampling; track per-agent exposure counts and belief updates.

Add event logs and counters (purchases, enforcement actions, misinformation exposures) and compute all required metrics (adoption_rate_over_time, peak, time_to_70, sustained_over_80, inequality Gini, policy effect size via counterfactual, average masks purchased/person, enforcement count, misinformation exposure rate).
Make calibrators honor the provided evaluator callback; add a flag to disable per-trial artifact saving and reuse static state to reduce I/O and runtime.
Refactor parse_json/validate_plan to raise exceptions instead of sys.exit and fix seeding to always use registry.get_param_or('random_seed', default) with CLI override.
Revise transitions tracking to per-day counts or rolling windows to avoid cumulative denominator inflation.
Add unit tests for schema adaptation, purchases, enforcement, misinformation, and metrics; verify determinism with seeds.
